title: Note values: how long notes last
examples: How long does a whole note last in music?
If I play a quarter note, how many beats is that?
What is the difference between a half note and a quarter note?

explain.say: Today we will learn about note values in music.

draw.text: Note values: how long notes last

explain.say: The whole note lasts for four beats in time.
A half note lasts for two beats in music time.
A quarter note lasts for one single beat.
An eighth note lasts for half of a beat.
In a group of four beats, you can fit four quarter notes.

faq.q: How many beats does a whole note last?
faq.a: A whole note lasts for four beats of time. You can also say it lasts for four beats. Another way is to ask how long a whole note is.
asks: How many beats are in a whole note?
What is the time value of a whole note?

faq.q: If I play two half notes, how many beats is that?
faq.a: Two half notes together will last for four beats. You can also ask what the total beats are for two half notes. Another way is to ask for the total duration.
asks: What is the total beat count?

faq.q: Is an eighth note half a beat?
faq.a: Yes, an eighth note lasts for half a beat. You could also ask for the duration of an eighth note. Another way is to ask what fraction of a beat it is.

faq.q: How do I know which note is which?
faq.a: You can look at the musical notation symbols. The shape of the note tells you how long it should sound. Another way is to count the beats shown in the music. You might also ask to see the symbols.
asks: What do the note heads look like?
Can you show me the symbols?

faq.q: Does the beat change for different notes?
faq.a: The beat value stays the same for a specific note type. For example, a quarter note always equals one beat. You could ask if the beat is constant. Another way is to ask about the beat pattern.
asks: Is the beat always the same?
Does the note value affect the beat?

facts: A whole note receives four beats of time.
A half note receives two beats of time.
A quarter note receives one beat of time.
An eighth note receives one half beat of time.

quiz.say: If you play one whole note, how many beats have passed?
quiz.why: The whole note is the longest note and lasts for four beats.

wrong.0: This is the length of a half note, which is shorter.
wrong.1: This is the length of a quarter note, which is much shorter.
wrong.2: This is too long; you cannot fit eight beats in a simple measure.

quiz.say: How many beats do two quarter notes equal?
quiz.why: Since one quarter note is one beat, two quarter notes equal two beats.

wrong.0: This is the length of a whole note, which is too long.
wrong.1: This is the length of an eighth note, which is too short.
wrong.3: This only accounts for one of the notes played.

quiz.say: If a measure contains one half note and two quarter notes, how many beats are there total?
quiz.why: You add the beats: two beats from the half note plus two beats from the two quarter notes equals four beats.

wrong.0: This only counts the half note and ignores the quarter notes.
wrong.1: This is too short and does not account for all the notes.
wrong.3: This forgets that the two quarter notes together make two beats.
